title: add-benchmark-lab-profiling-baselines-and-reporting-pipeline-v30
author: Maya Chen
description:
Add v30 of the benchmark-lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline. Motivation: recent model changes and new KV-cache batching behavior require updated baselines and an end-to-end reporting pipeline that normalizes profiles across GPU types and quantization configurations. This PR introduces representative workload runners for conversational and completion traces, new profiling baselines (cold-start and steady-state) for NVLink and PCIe clusters, and a lightweight reporting pipeline that aggregates p95/p99 latency, token throughput, and memory footprint into a standardized BigQuery schema.

What changed (high level): added workload runners, profiling harness, pipeline YAML/configs, dashboard generators, and CI integrations to run a subset of profiling tests on PRs. Includes docs and local run scripts.

Why this is safe: all new runners are behind a feature flag (BENCHMARK_LAB_V30) and default CI profile uses a small sample trace to avoid long runs. No changes to runtime code paths for production serving.

Migration notes: ops should run the included migration script to create new BigQuery datasets and update the reporting service SA. See docs/benchmark-lab/README-v30.md for step-by-step.

Testing checklist:
- [x] Unit tests for runner orchestration
- [x] Integration test for reporting pipeline (mocked sink)
- [x] Manual runs on staging NVLink cluster
- [x] Dashboard snapshot generator validated

Related Linear tickets: ENG-1428 (v30 profiling scope), ENG-1483 (reporting pipeline schema).
